Building an inbound funnel on LinkedIn used to take weeks.

Today, combining relevant content and relational automation lets you book sales meetings while you sleep.

Here are the 3 essential steps:
1. Publish content with calls to action based on high-value assets.
2. Monitor comments for trigger keywords.
3. Deliver the resource instantly via direct message.

Comment "{keyword}" below and I will send you the complete PDF framework at no cost.

plans.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions about Account Slots
plans.faq1A: A slot represents an active slot allowing you to connect 1 personal LinkedIn profile to the platform. If you subscribe to Growth Plan (5 slots), you can connect up to 5 concurrent profiles and distribute them across your team.
plans.faq2Q: Can I reassign or change a connected account?
plans.faq2A: Yes. You can disconnect an account at any time to release the slot and connect a different profile at no extra cost.
plans.faq3Q: What daily safety limits apply to each account?
plans.faq3A: Each profile operates independently with human pacing (random pauses of 3 to 12 minutes) and a safe cap of 20-25 connection invites and 30-40 direct messages daily to prevent restrictions.
plans.faq4Q: How does multi-operator management and the 3 roles work?
plans.faq4A: The platform provides 3 roles: Super Admin, Admin, and Team. On the Starter Plan (1 slot), access is exclusive to Admin. On Growth Plan (5 slots), Admin can invite collaborators. On Business Plan (10 slots), Admin can invite up to 9 operators.
